title: Ootip
summary: Ootip links a GitHub repository to a Tari Ootle tip jar, with split payouts for up to 16 maintainers. The jar owner sets the shares; anyone can tip or distribute its balance. The creator reports testing on Esmeralda with Sapient 0.9.4. Tips use a public balance: the jar balance, amounts, split, note and signing account are public. Direct private tips are not implemented, and the mainnet template address is pending. The November 9 recording shows the public documentation and these limits; no wallet connection or transaction was performed.
cardSummary: Support open-source maintainers with a shared tip jar and split payouts on Tari’s Esmeralda testnet.
creator: GeiserX

recording.credit: Docs walkthrough — tip jars and public-payment limits
